labels.chatbot.integrations.embedCheck.descript: Check that ragsuite-init.js and the backend loader are reachable before pasting the script into TYPO3.
labels.chatbot.integrations.embedCheck.runA11y: Check embed init and loader URLs
Ready — init and loader responded OK.
Partial — init OK; loader could not be fully verified (often CORS). Script tags may still work.
Not ready — fix missing/unreachable URLs before TYPO3.
labels.chatbot.integrations.embedCheck.partialH: Browsers block some fetch checks even when <script src> works. If init is OK, paste into a local test page and confirm the widget appears.
labels.chatbot.integrations.embedCheck.failedHi: Ensure the admin host serves /widget/v1/ragsuite-init.js, loader.js, and /embed/chatbot (run npm run sync-widget-assets before export). Set WIDGET_ASSET_BASE if the widget host differs from this admin.
labels.chatbot.integrations.mobile.instructions: Install the Mobile SDK in your Expo or mobile app (see install command below).
Set projectId, apiKey (rgs_live_… from Integrations → API Keys), and endpoint in RAGSuiteProvider.
Add RAGSuiteChat inside RAGSuiteProvider with features={['chat']}.
Rebuild the app and verify on a device or simulator — do not use the web embed token in mobile apps.
